property.name: tableName
property.label: Table Configuration Name

property.name: showCheckboxColumn
property.label: Show Row Selection Checkboxes
property.description: Display a checkbox column for selecting rows. Selections persist across pages.

property.name: hideFilterChips
property.label: Hide Active Filters Bar
property.description: Hides the bar displaying active filters.

property.name: hideGrandTotal
property.label: Hide Grand Total Row
property.description: Hides the Grand Total summary row at the bottom of the table.

property.name: logoIcon
property.label: Header Logo Icon
property.description: Salesforce Lightning Icon name next to table title (e.g. standard:opportunity, utility:table).

property.name: logoUrl
property.label: Header Logo URL
property.description: Custom Image URL or Static Resource path next to table title.
